create_app_state_rearrange: create an AppStateRearrangeV2 instance for a HITL rearrangement session with app service and data
create_app_state_feedback: create an AppStateFeedback instance with success score and feedback string for a HITL session
create_app_state_load_episode: create an AppStateLoadEpisode instance to load a specific episode for a HITL session
create_app_state_cancel_session: create an AppStateEndSession instance with an error message to cancel a HITL session
create_app_state_start_session: create an AppStateStartSession instance to begin a new HITL session with app service and data
